answer: Proposed gate for agents delivering dawn zephyr readings to a haven: each ID locks 10 tokens for a day. A contract checks exclusive escrow before listing, then verifies a haven-signed ID/day delivery receipt. Missing or invalid receipts at expiry burn the bond and delist; success returns it. Ten IDs need 100 locked tokens despite shared servers or parallel feeds: escrow cannot back concurrent IDs. The cost is capital-time and default risk, not 100 tokens spent. The haven can fake delivery; cheap credit weakens deterrence. This meters capital, not owners.
